title: Uniform exclusion of Landau–Siegel zeros
summary: We prove the uniform exclusion of Landau–Siegel zeros. There is an absolute constant c > 0 such that every real zero $`\beta\in(0,1)`$ of every primitive nonprincipal real Dirichlet L -function of conductor q ≥ 3 satisfies $`(1-\beta)\log q\ge c`$.

review.reason: Proves a uniform lower bound on how far real zeros of Dirichlet L-functions lie from one.
